# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "W1003 unused_import"
description: "An imported name is never used in this module: not in a value, a type, a pattern or a @contract_test attribute."
---

A warning from the `resolve` phase. `sakura explain W1003` prints this explanation offline.

An imported name is never used in this module: not in a value, a type, a pattern or a
`@contract_test` attribute. The fix removes the name, or the whole `import` when nothing it
brings is used, so `sakura fix` applies it (design §17.294 RQ-5).

Warning:

```sakura
import std/json.{DecodeError, Json}
fn show(n: Int) -> String { Json.encode(n) }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
import std/json.{Json}
fn show(n: Int) -> String { Json.encode(n) }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/W1003_unused_import.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/W1003_unused_import.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
// §17.294 RQ-5: one W1003 per unused imported name. `Json`, the last of its list, goes with the
// comma before it and `Level`, the first, with the comma after it; the `import`s of `retry`,
// `crypto` and `Violation` go whole. A name used in a value (`None`), only in a type
// (`DecodeError`), only in a pattern (`Some`) or only in a `@contract_test` attribute (`Log`)
// is used.
import std/core.{Violation}
import std/crypto
import std/json.{DecodeError, Json}
import std/log.{Level, Log}
import std/option.{None, Some}
import std/retry.{retry}

@contract_test(handlers: [Log.captured()])
pub fn show(n: Int) -> String
  requires n > 0
{ "{n}" }

pub fn same(e: DecodeError) -> DecodeError { e }

pub fn is_some(o: Option<Int>) -> Bool {
  match o {
    Some(_) => true,
    _ => false,
  }
}

pub fn nothing() -> Option<Int> { None }
```

{ "{n}" }

pub fn is_some(o: Option<Int>) -> Bool {
  match o {
    Some(_) => true,
    _ => false,
  }
}

pub fn nothing() -> Option<Int> { None }
